---
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["p > span#raw-paragraph", "li > span#raw-list-item", "#destination > #source"]
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ["#destination"]
        matches: ["Reused content"]
---

`<span id="raw-paragraph">Raw paragraph</span>`{=html}

- `<span id="raw-list-item">Raw list item</span>`{=html}

::: {#source}
Reused content
:::

::: {#destination}
{{< contents source >}}
:::
